summary: Accept all eight cases with the existing diagnostic expectations. Both runtime-control omissions from the preserved rejected receipt are fixed. Independent Docker execution with assertions disabled passes, and an isolated public-harness rerun reproduces the expected analyzer verdicts. No remaining actionable findings.

prior_review.status: Preserved unchanged. Its diagnostic-expectation assessment is accepted; its two runtime findings are resolved by this follow-up.
results: The prior review inspected all eight manifests, fixtures, runtime scripts and configurations, found eight distinct semantic criteria, and validated 26 cases with zero invalid.

Its independent stable eight-case run passed runtime 8/8. PHPStan 2.3.1 had seven ok and one excluded divergence; Psalm 6.20.0 had seven ok and one false positive; Mago 1.57.0 had five ok and three false positives. No false negatives, tool errors or case errors. Evidence: .amp/in/artifacts/review-run-eight/report.json.

The prior review accepted PHPStan's optional PHPDoc widening exclusion from pinned implementation and default configuration. It justified enum literal nullable reports at line 20 as false positives, variable-input nullable reports at line 25 as required, and the duplicate Mago invalid-argument at template-bound line 21 as an allowed report of the same violation.

The prior receipt records inspection of historical/stable/main raw outputs, pinned upstream source and reproducer leads. Those are prior-review evidence, not newly inspected comparison results in this follow-up.
